scope: Selected native calls and actual S3 bytes establish payload projections, admission, current PutRecord authority and rule-Region routing independently of retained target ARN. Native propagation allowed some earlier denied markers through and rejected some early recovery markers: replay selects settled observations, not propagation cadence. JSON member order, event IDs, object packing and service timing are not pinned. SQLite reopen around accepted buffers, target state and denied authority exercises local persistence. Null input is measured for admission, not native delivery. Missing-resource execution, trust propagation, throttling, cross-partition routing and retry exhaustion remain unmeasured.
